[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/google-play-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/google-play-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de apps do play.google.com (Google Play Store), escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Google Play App Reviews and Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-google-play-app-reviews-and-data)
- **Código:** [`google_play.py`](google_play.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [App](results/app.json) · [Reviews](results/reviews.json) · [Search](results/search.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Páginas de detalhes de apps do Google Play para dados de apps
- Avaliações de apps do Google Play
- Páginas de busca do Google Play para dados de listagem de apps

## Funções

- `scrape_apps(app_ids, lang='en', country='us')` → `List[Dict]`: scrape Google Play app detail pages
- `scrape_reviews(app_id, lang='en', country='us', sort=Sort.NEWEST, max_reviews=100, filter_score_with=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape app reviews via the Play Store batchexecute endpoint
- `scrape_search(query, lang='en', country='us')` → `List[Dict]`: scrape Google Play search results

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import google_play


async def main():
    apps = await google_play.scrape_apps(app_ids=["com.whatsapp", "com.spotify.music"])
    reviews = await google_play.scrape_reviews(app_id="com.whatsapp", max_reviews=100)
    search = await google_play.scrape_search(query="Music")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/app.json`](results/app.json): `title`, `description`, `descriptionHTML`, `summary`, `installs`, `minInstalls`, `realInstalls`, `score`, `ratings`, `reviews`, `histogram`, `price`, `free`, `currency`, `offersIAP`, `inAppProductPrice`, `developer`, `developerId`, `developerEmail`, `developerWebsite`, `developerAddress`, `privacyPolicy`, `genre`, `genreId`, `categories`, `icon`, `headerImage`, `screenshots`, `video`, `videoImage`, `contentRating`, `contentRatingDescription`, `adSupported`, `containsAds`, `released`, `lastUpdatedOn`, `updated`, `version`, `comments`, `appId`, … (1 mais)
- [`results/reviews.json`](results/reviews.json): `reviewId`, `userName`, `userImage`, `content`, `score`, `thumbsUpCount`, `reviewCreatedVersion`, `at`, `replyContent`, `repliedAt`, `appVersion`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `appId`, `icon`, `screenshots`, `title`, `score`, `genre`, `price`, `free`, `currency`, `video`, `videoImage`, `description`, `descriptionHTML`, `developer`, `installs`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`google_play.py`](google_play.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"US"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/google-play-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_app_scraping`, `test_reviews_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
